title: Database OOM killed, no restart policy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the database as the broken part, memory exhaustion as the problem, and the new analytics endpoint in API 2.3.2 as the trigger.
root_cause: The new analytics endpoint in API version 2.3.2 executes a heavyweight database query that exhausts the PostgreSQL container's memory, triggering the Linux OOM killer (signal 9) and terminating the DB process.
truth: A new analytics endpoint in api 2.3.2 ran a massive query that pushed PostgreSQL over its 1 GB memory limit, causing the kernel to OOM-kill it. The database container has no restart policy, so it stayed down.
